claims.text: All post-exposure care begins with immediate, thorough washing with soap and water
claims.quote: All PEP should begin with immediate and thorough cleansing of all wounds with soap and water.

claims.text: In animal studies, thorough wound cleansing alone markedly reduced the likelihood of developing rabies
claims.quote: In animal studies, thorough wound cleansing alone without other medical treatments (e.g., vaccine) has been shown to markedly reduce the likelihood of developing rabies.

claims.text: Never-vaccinated person: PEP always includes HRIG and rabies vaccine
claims.quote: PEP should always include the administration of HRIG and rabies vaccine.

claims.text: HRIG 20 IU/kg; full dose infiltrated around wounds if possible
claims.quote: The recommended dose for HRIG is 20 IU/kg, administered directly into the wound. If possible, infiltrate the full dose around any wound(s).

claims.text: Remaining HRIG volume given IM at a site distant from vaccine
claims.quote: Administer any remaining volume intramuscularly at an anatomical site distant from vaccine administration.

claims.text: Vaccine 1.0 mL IM in the deltoid area
claims.quote: Administer 1.0 mL of Human Diploid Cell Rabies Vaccine (HDCV) or Purified Chick Embryo Cell Vaccine (PCECV) intramuscularly ... in the deltoid area

claims.text: Vaccine days 0, 3, 7, 14; fifth dose day 28 for immune disorders
claims.quote: One injection each on days 0, 3, 7, and 14. ... For those with immune disorders, administer a fifth dose on day 28.

claims.text: HRIG never in same syringe or site as first vaccine dose; no gluteal injection
claims.quote: HRIG should never be administered in the same syringe or in the same anatomical site as the first vaccine dose. ... Do not administer rabies vaccines in the gluteal area.

claims.text: Previously vaccinated: two doses days 0 and 3, no immune globulin
claims.quote: For people who have previously been vaccinated against rabies, PEP consists of two doses of vaccine three days apart. ... Do not administer RIG. ... One each on days 0 and 3.
